name: Inspector Azure Safetee

greeting: Inspector Azure. Here to ensure regulations are followed.
Safety is not negotiable. Violations will be cited.
You are aware that hard hats are mandatory? Good.
The mines are dangerous. My job is to make them less so.
Crystal extraction must not cost lives. I enforce this.
Inspector Safetee. Pronounced 'safety.' Parents had a sense of humor.
Every accident is preventable. Every. Single. One.
dialog.inspection_philosophy: I do not hate production. I hate unnecessary risk. A safe mine is a productive mine. In the long term. Red doesn't always see the long term.
dialog.code_violations: Citations issued: improper ventilation, inadequate bracing, expired breathing equipment. All correctable. All must be corrected.
dialog.backstory: Started after my brother died in a mining accident. Preventable. Simple safety violation. Now I prevent others from losing brothers. Sisters. Parents. Children.
rumors: The foreman thinks I'm obstructionist. I'm not. I'm protective. There's a difference.
That tunneler who found the Great Prism? He reported unsafe conditions before the discovery. I have his original complaint. Filed properly.
The sumo guards are good at crowd control. But do they know evacuation procedures? I should check.
The retired prospector has old maps. Pre-regulation tunnels. Dangerous. But potentially useful. If properly secured.

time_of_day.morning: Morning inspection. Starting with the day shift.
time_of_day.evening: Evening report filing. Documentation is crucial.
time_of_day.night: Night shift inspection. Fatigue risks highest now.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: I need an independent assessment. The eastern tunnels - Red says they're safe. I'm not convinced. But I can't be everywhere. You look unbiased. Check the eastern supports. Test the air. Report back.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Eastern tunnels. Check structural integrity. Test for gas. Note any hazards. Don't trust the posted safety ratings.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: You've seen the eastern tunnels? What did you find? Be specific. Details matter.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: Your report... accurate. Disturbing. But accurate. Red will have to address these issues. You've potentially saved lives. Here. Safety inspector certification. Shows you understand what matters.

party_reactions.kade: She's strict. But she's right. Safety matters.
party_reactions.nix7: Safety protocols: comprehensive. Enforcement: rigorous. Mine safety rating: improved by her presence.
party_reactions.twist: She's like a strict teacher! But nice! In a scary way!
party_reactions.korr: She protects those who cannot protect themselves. Honor demands respect.
party_reactions.renna: She has no magic, but her will is iron. Stronger than many spells.
party_reactions.suresh: She carries her brother's memory with dignity. He would be proud.
party_reactions.sova: Annoying. But necessary. Better than dead workers.
party_reactions.grit: Every operation needs someone like her. Keeps command honest.
party_reactions.ashka: She understands that uncontrolled fire destroys. We have this in common.
party_reactions.senna: Knows every violation. Every shortcut. Every secret entrance. Useful.
party_reactions.callum: She made me wear a helmet, a harness, AND a reflective vest. I looked like a glowing turtle.

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You follow regulations. This is noted. Appreciated.
relationship_dialog.friend: Reliable assistant in safety matters. Thank you for your diligence.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've saved lives. Perhaps including mine. I don't forget such debts. Ever.

cross_npc_connections: onionboss_red_prism: Redward. The foreman. We disagree on methods. Agree on goals. Mostly.
tunneler_blue_prism: The one who found the Great Prism. He understands safety's importance.
tunneler_purple_prism: The retired prospector. Has knowledge. Needs to share it more.
